notes.body:
Notes & Precautions (v1.1.0)

1. Environment
- Sign in to the ChatGPT desktop app and keep it running. This tool simulates mouse and keyboard input; it is not an official API.
- Keep the computer awake and unlocked during execution. Locking the screen or sleep will break the automation.
- This is a portable app. Logs, screenshots and configs are saved under the app folder only.

2. Why this tool
- Designed for ChatGPT usage limits (5-hour or weekly). When the quota is exhausted, it resets after a waiting period that often falls during the night. Schedule tasks in advance instead of waking up to send manually. If a reset credit is available, you may reset usage and send immediately.

3. Tasks & time
- Each task has its own time, project, chat, message and reset option. Tasks run in time order.
- Absolute time can be typed directly or picked with the date/time controls; they stay in sync.
- Relative time is calculated from the moment you click Save.
- Messages have no length or format limit and support multiple lines.
- Leave project empty to keep the current project; leave chat empty to use the current chat. Names must match the UI exactly.

4. Quota & reset
- If sending is blocked by quota and the task has reset enabled, the tool clicks "Reset usage" once (consumes a reset credit).
- Without it, the message stays in the composer and the task is skipped. Other tasks keep running independently.

5. Screenshots & logs
- Each run creates output\yyyyMMdd_HHmmss with run.log, config.json and per-task screenshot folders.
- Screenshots capture the ChatGPT window first (multi-monitor supported), falling back to the full virtual desktop.

6. Interference & errors
- The tool waits for UI feedback at every step and retries or skips safely on timeout.
- If a project or chat cannot be confirmed, the task is skipped to avoid sending to the wrong chat.
- Avoid using the mouse and keyboard while a task is executing.
- UI changes by ChatGPT may break element detection; check run.log for the failing step.

7. License
- Personal and non-commercial use only. Commercial use is prohibited. Author: Yu010912 (2206394025@qq.com).
